title: Deep Brain Stimulation (DBS) Retrospective Outcomes Study
official: Deep Brain Stimulation (DBS) Retrospective Outcomes Study
summary: The primary objective of this study is to characterize real-world clinical outcomes of Deep Brain Stimulation (DBS) using retrospective review of de-identified patient records.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Must be previously treated with or eligible for implantation with a deep brain stimulation system

Exclusion Criteria:

* No Exclusion Criteria
